name: smwmusic-mega-man-x2-dangerous-reef-bubble-crab-s-stage-remix
title: Mega Man X2 - Dangerous Reef ~ Bubble Crab's Stage (Remix)
description:
A remix I did months ago of Bubble Crab's stage theme from Mega Man X2.

This baby can fit in underwater stages and (flooded) caverns.

Note:
- There is a "READ ME.txt" file that has the sample bank. You'll need to move what's in that file into "Addmusic_sample_groups.txt."
- The Thunder SFX, Yoshi SFX, and @7 are disabled.
